We evaluate on the Calvin ABC-D task. We train the model for 30k steps on the
ABC splits and evaluate it on 1000 task sequences, each with a length of 5. During testing, the policy
is required to complete a sequence of 1–5 tasks. This setup challenges the VLM’s ability to generalize
to novel visual scenes. We report the average number of successfully completed tasks per sequence.

SimplerEnv Bridge
To better differentiate the performance of various VLM-based policies, we
choose the WindowX (Bridge V2) task suite, which is more challenging than the Fractal suite.
We train for 50k steps on Bridge-V2 (Walke et al., 2023). During evaluation, we run 24 trials
with random initializations for each of the four scenes (Pick Carrot, Pick Eggplant, Pick
Spoon, and Stack Cube) and calculate the success rate.

datasets.name: Robopoint

and a target location, the model is required to output the 2D coordinates that satisfy the target

datasets.name: Vica-332k

covers a wide range of capabilities, including size estimation, position understanding, distance

improvement of ∼15% on VSI-Bench Yang et al. (2025).

datasets.name: Bridgevqa

includes judging the distance, size, and depth between two objects.

datasets.name: Robo2vlm

on this dataset, we achieved a 60% performance improvement on its test set.
